model.name: Bitcoin Icons: Open‑Source Icon Library for Bitcoin & Web3 Design
model.description:
Bitcoin Icons: Open‑Source Icon Library for Bitcoin & Web3 Design


Browse and insert 80+ Bitcoin‑centric SVG icons directly inside Figma. Built for wallets, exchanges, and any application in the Bitcoin ecosystem.


Why use Bitcoin Icons?


  1. Bitcoin‑first icons – Includes Bitcoin‑specific symbols like wallet, node, mining device, keys, lightning, and multiple Satoshi avatars – alongside essential UI icons (arrows, home, search, etc.).
  2. Open‑source & free – Part of the Bitcoin Design Community initiative. Use them in commercial or personal projects with no licensing fees.
  3. Figma‑native workflow – Insert icons as clean vector components, then resize, recolor, and restyle without leaving your design file.
  4. Design‑dev ready – The same icons are available as React and Vue components (@bitcoin-design/bitcoin-icons-react / -vue), raw SVGs on GitHub, and an npm package – so your developers can match your design exactly.
  5. Community‑driven – Contribute new icons, report issues, or suggest improvements on GitHub. The project gets better with your feedback.


Perfect for:


  1. UI/UX designers building Bitcoin wallets, exchanges, DeFi dashboards, or payment interfaces.
  2. Web3 product teams that need a consistent visual language for Bitcoin applications.
  3. Frontend developers looking for a design‑to‑code icon workflow that works.
  4. Open‑source contributors who want to help shape Bitcoin’s design ecosystem.
